markdown:
# How we handle eBilling and A/R

eBilling and accounts receivable are the focus of Phase 3 of our growth plan. We plan to consolidate the work through acquisitions and run it with four finance AI agents, priced on how quickly clients get paid (Frontline growth plan).

## Why law firms need help now

- Client-side AI now reviews law-firm invoices more strictly.
- Invoice rejections have risen from 11% to 18% (Frontline growth plan).
- Rejections slow cash, so billing accuracy is a bigger concern for firms than before.

## How the service works

- **Consolidation by acquisition.** We are screening specialist billing providers, including Helm360, The Garver Group and The Legal Billing Group (Frontline growth plan).
- **Four finance agents.** AI agents handle parts of the billing and collections workflow. The context does not say what each agent does. A service design document would answer that.
- **Outcome-based pricing.** Fees are tied to days-to-pay, not hours worked (Frontline growth plan).
- **International reach later.** Phase 4 adds UK and Canada providers, including Accurate Legal Billing (Frontline growth plan).

## Timing and scale

| Point in plan | What happens | Acquired revenue (cumulative, est.) |
|---|---|---|
| Months 12-30 | Phase 3 consolidates eBilling and A/R | — |
| Month 24 | Phase 3 underway | ~$25M, MSP and billing add-ons combined |
| Month 36 | Phase 3 complete | ~$55M, all add-ons |

Month zero is the October 2026 run-rate, so Phase 3 would start around October 2027 (est.) (Frontline growth plan). The roadmap does not show eBilling revenue on its own. A line-of-business forecast would answer that.

## What we cannot yet say

- How much of today's 900+ law-firm client base already buys billing services.
- Days-to-pay results from the current book.
- Target pricing per invoice or per firm.

All revenue and margin figures are analyst estimates, not company disclosures (Frontline public filings).

With the deal bought at about 12-15x EBITDA (est.), EBITDA growth has to carry the return. Billing work priced on cash outcomes gives us a new revenue line that is tied directly to what a managing partner watches most closely (Frontline public filings).

## Next actions

1. Measure current billing clients and their baseline days-to-pay, so outcome pricing has a starting point.
2. Write the specification for the four finance agents, including scope, handoffs to staff and the pricing trigger.
3. Rank Helm360, The Garver Group and The Legal Billing Group on revenue, overlap with our client base and fit with our offshore delivery.
4. Add a separate eBilling and A/R line to the KPI roadmap.
